hints.title: Formula Evaluation
hints.text: The value at index i is defined as start + 2 * i.

hints.title: Iterative XOR
hints.text: Initialize accumulator to 0 and loop i from 0 through n - 1, bitwise xor-ing each computed element.

hints.title: Direct Loop
hints.text: Given n <= 1000, a direct O(N) loop is immediate, concise, and fully optimal.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(N) direct loop succeeds easily within constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra space and linear time loop.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles bitwise xor syntax accurately.
complexity.notes: An O(1) mathematical solution using xor patterns of consecutive numbers also exists.
